scope: Initial read-only diagnosis of the hardware fault and numerical/GUI regression checks. The later successful 20-2000 Hz hardware verification is linked below.

finding.fault: Measured peak limit: Control Accel reached 0.94058 g (limit 0.85 g).

interpretation: A sharp amplitude reduction at nonzero phase preceded a brief response transient, consistent with excitation by the voltage discontinuity. The later sweep completed with smooth corrections; this supports the fix without independently proving the physical cause.

changes.amplitude_transition: 20 ms raised-cosine envelope on sine command changes, retaining oscillator phase and response stops
changes.live_status: Remaining minimum dwell displayed separately from tracking settlement

verification.specific_regression: 20 to 21.189 Hz, two different plant gains, a queued acquisition block, and corrections at nonzero phase; completes without a boundary voltage step
verification.app: Reopened with corrected preset and previous reports; Ready, Stop disabled, no acquisition started

limits: The earlier 200 Hz hold and 100-500 Hz sweeps predate this correction. Follow-up verification of the corrected 20-2000 Hz sweep is recorded separately below.
